{{Top|leg}}
'''Morgraine Delefrenquin''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] working for the ''[[Chandrilan Daily Messenger]]'' as the Society News Editor. Delefrenquin reported on [[Quintana Trill]]'s arrival at the [[Imperial Cavalcade of Stars]] for the premiere of her new [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]], ''[[Denizens of Dakaret IX]]''.<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
